verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no export capability for customer, alert, case or decision data. It shows External Entity ID management and entity merging, which concern identifiers, plus real-time Events API responses and webhooks, which are integration paths rather than data export for reconciliation. These are adjacent building blocks, not the export capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export customer, alert, case and decision data with stable identifiers for reconciliation
